Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: They reported the Cincinnati-to-Augusta distance as ~508.1 miles “via I-90,” which reflects Augusta, Georgia, not Augusta, Maine. This destination/route mix-up drastically undercounted the total miles (and thus bottles), leading to the incorrect refund. Subsequent issues (rounding bottles instead of miles, assuming deposit) did not drive the main error.
